data.name: Abeel
data.gender_notes: Abeel is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Abeel is an Arabic and Persian name that means gentle, kind, and devoted. This name has been used for both girls and boys in Muslim cultures and is considered a spiritual and meaningful choice for parents looking for an Islamic name. The name Abeel carries the meaning “Gentle, Kind, Devoted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Abeel usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, kind, devoted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nurturing and caring for others is a key aspect of the spiritual meaning of Abeel. It reminds us to be kind and gentle in our actions and words, and to always show devotion to those we care about.
data.etymology: Abeel belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Kind, Devoted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abeel total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: أبيل
in_arabic.long_meaning: أبيل هو اسم عربي يعود إلى الجذور الساميّة، ويعني الرجل ذو العقل والفهم، وهو من الأسماء التي تشير إلى الذكاء والتفكير الصحيح، ويستخدم في التراث الإسلامي لوصف الشخص المتفكّر والمُتقن للعلوم والفنون

in_urdu.name: ابیل
in_urdu.long_meaning: ابیل ایک عربي نام ہے جو سميّي gốc سے ماخوذ ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے عقلmand اور سمجھ بوجھ، یہ نام दक्षिण ایشیائی مسلمان روایت میں علم اور فنون کے ماہر شخص کی وضاحت کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: अबील
in_hindi.long_meaning: अबील एक अरबी नाम है जो समी मूल से लिया गया है, और इसका अर्थ है बुद्धिमत्ता और समझ, यह नाम भारतीय मुसलमान समुदाय में विद्वान और कला के जानकार व्यक्ति के वर्णन के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: ابیل
